indications_and_usage: LIPITOR is indicated as an adjunct to diet to reduce elevated total-C, LDL-C, apo B, and TG levels and to increase HDL-C in patients with primary hyperlipidemia.
dosage_and_administration: The recommended starting dose of LIPITOR is 10 or 20 mg once daily. Dose range is 10 to 80 mg once daily.
warnings: Myopathy and Rhabdomyolysis: Rare cases of rhabdomyolysis with acute renal failure secondary to myoglobinuria have been reported with LIPITOR.
adverse_reactions: Most common adverse reactions are nasopharyngitis, arthralgia, diarrhea, pain in extremity, and urinary tract infection.

indications_and_usage: AUGMENTIN is indicated in the treatment of infections due to susceptible isolates of designated bacteria in lower respiratory tract infections, acute bacterial otitis media, sinusitis, and skin structure infections.
dosage_and_administration: Adults: One 625 mg tablet every 12 hours or one 500 mg tablet every 8 hours at the start of a meal.
warnings: Serious and occasionally fatal hypersensitivity (anaphylactic) reactions have been reported in patients on penicillin therapy.
adverse_reactions: The most frequently reported adverse effects were diarrhea/loose stools, nausea, skin rashes, and urticaria.

indications_and_usage: VENTOLIN HFA is indicated for the treatment or prevention of bronchospasm in patients 4 years of age and older with reversible obstructive airway disease.
dosage_and_administration: For treatment of acute episodes of bronchospasm: 2 inhalations repeated every 4 to 6 hours as needed.
warnings: Paradoxical Bronchospasm: Like other inhaled beta2-agonists, VENTOLIN HFA can produce paradoxical bronchospasm, which may be life threatening.
adverse_reactions: Common adverse reactions include throat irritation, viral respiratory infections, upper respiratory tract infection, tachycardia, and musculoskeletal pain.

indications_and_usage: CRESTOR is indicated as an adjunct to diet to reduce LDL-C, Total-C, and triglycerides, and to increase HDL-C in adult patients with hypertriglyceridemia.
dosage_and_administration: Dose range is 5 to 40 mg once daily. May be taken with or without food at any time of day.
warnings: Skeletal Muscle Effects (Myopathy and Rhabdomyolysis): Risk increases with higher doses.
adverse_reactions: Most frequent adverse reactions are headache, myalgia, abdominal pain, asthenia, and nausea.

indications_and_usage: For relief of the signs and symptoms of osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and ankylosing spondylitis.
dosage_and_administration: For osteoarthritis: 100-150 mg/day in divided doses (50 mg two or three times a day). Take with food.
warnings: Cardiovascular Thrombotic Events: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs cause an increased risk of serious cardiovascular thrombotic events, including myocardial infarction and stroke.
adverse_reactions: Abdominal pain, constipation, diarrhea, dyspepsia, flatulence, gross bleeding/perforation, heartburn, nausea, GI ulcers.

indications_and_usage: Relief of symptoms associated with seasonal allergic rhinitis and uncomplicated skin manifestations of chronic idiopathic urticaria.
dosage_and_administration: Adults: 120 mg or 180 mg once daily with water. Avoid fruit juices.
warnings: Do not administer with fruit juice as bioavailability is substantially decreased.
adverse_reactions: Headache, back pain, dizziness, fatigue, and nausea.

indications_and_usage: Lowering cholesterol and reducing the risk of heart disease and cardiovascular events.
warnings: Caution in patients with hepatic impairment and active liver disease.
adverse_reactions: Muscle pain, joint pain, nausea, mild indigestion.

indications_and_usage: Relief and prevention of airway bronchospasm in asthma and reversible obstructive airways disease.
dosage_and_administration: 1-2 puffs as required for sudden breathlessness.
warnings: Overuse can lead to tolerance and cardiac overstimulation.
